# has place name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](gmeow-hasPlaceName.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPlaceName>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a geographic [`gmeow:Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md) to a structured [`gmeow:PlaceName`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceName.md) (toponym) it bears; the place-scoped specialization of [`gmeow:hasAppellation`](gmeow-hasAppellation.md), mirroring [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md) for persons. Non-functional — a place bears many co-equal names (endonym/exonym, multilingual, historical); none is primary, and superseded ones set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false. The structured, first-class replacement for the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bear a structured toponym on a geographic place — an endonym, exonym, multilingual, or historical name; the place-scoped mirror of [`gmeow:hasName`](gmeow-hasName.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid the retired flat gmeow:alternateName literal and avoid privileging one toponym as primary — names are co-equal; carry period and toponymic authority by promoting to a [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceNaming.md), and set superseded names [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.

### How to use

- Assert one [`hasPlaceName`](gmeow-hasPlaceName.md) triple per co-equal [`gmeow:PlaceName`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceName.md); tag endonym/exonym with [`gmeow:namePurpose`](gmeow-namePurpose.md) on the name, and reify to a [`gmeow:PlaceNaming`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceNaming.md) when authority or interval must be borne.

### Examples

- ex:istanbul [`gmeow:hasPlaceName`](gmeow-hasPlaceName.md) ex:istanbulName, ex:constantinopleName.
